description: Turn a list inside each item into separate items, one per array element.

fieldsToSplitOut.description: Field path(s) (dot notation, e.g. "data.results") whose array values should each become a separate output item. When multiple fields are given, their arrays are zipped together by index.

include.description: Which other fields from the original item to carry into each split-out item.

fieldsToInclude.description: Field paths to carry over when include is "selectedOtherFields".

destinationFieldName.description: When splitting exactly one field, rename its output key to this instead of keeping the original field path.

disableDotNotation.description: Treat field paths as literal keys instead of dot-notation nested paths.
